caption: quaesito: questions on the TV, answers on your phones
text: Welcome to quaesito! The questions go up on the TV, and every team answers right from their phone.
say: Welcome to Kwehzeetoh! The questions go up on the TV, and every team answers right from their phone!

caption: Teams join with the QR code and pick a picture
text: Teams join by scanning the QR code, then pick a name and a picture. Easy peasy!
say: Teams join by scanning the QR code, then pick a name and a picture. Easy peasy.

caption: Slides introduce the rounds
text: Slides kick off each round. Let's go!
say: Slides kick off each round. Let's go!

caption: Multiple choice: faster right answers earn more
text: First up, multiple choice! The faster you answer correctly, the more points you score.
say: First up, multiple choice! The faster you answer correctly, the more points you score!

caption: True or false
text: True or false? Quick and snappy!
say: True or false? Quick and snappy!

caption: Typed answers, judged by the host
text: Typed answers are grouped on the big screen, so the host can judge them in a flash, even with half points!
say: Typed answers are grouped on the big screen, so the host can judge them in a flash. Even with half points!

caption: Closest number wins
text: How many keys on a piano? The closest guess wins!
say: How many keys on a piano? The closest guess wins!

caption: Put them in order
text: Put them in order, oldest first! Every item in the right place scores.
say: Put them in order, oldest first! Every item in the right place scores!

caption: Several answers in one question, ×2 points
text: Several answers in one question, and this one is worth double points!
say: Several answers in one question, and this one is worth double points!

caption: Drop a pin on the picture
text: Drop a pin on the picture. The closer you get, the more you win!
say: Drop a pin on the picture. The closer you get, the more you win!

caption: And the winner is…
text: And the winner is… drumroll, please!
say: And the winner is... drumroll, please!

caption: Free and open source: github.com/ggirelli/quaesito
text: Best of all, quaesito is free and open source. Grab it, and host your own quiz night!
say: Best of all, Kwehzeetoh is free and open source. Grab it, and host your own quiz night!
